questions.question: Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe the interior of a house?
The English expression for 'C'est confortable' is 'It's cozy'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe the interior of a house when it's spacious?
The English expression for 'C'est spacieux' is 'It's spacious'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe the interior of a house when it's modern?
The English expression for 'C'est moderne' is 'It's modern'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe the interior of a house when it's old-fashioned?
'The English expression for 'C'est démodé' is 'It's old-fashioned'' is a true statement.
